key_facts.reason_jp: 資本コスト意識経営、ROE 改善目標

summary_en: ROE 0.78% (FY3/26), WACC 3.00%, ROIC 0.46%, PBR 0.40x. Target ROE 2.20% by FY3/29 via revenue growth, gross-margin improvement, SG&A control, and ongoing evaluation of buyback and dividend increases. Execution aligned with 3-year plan (FY3/27–3/29).
summary_jp: ROE 0.78% (FY3/26)、WACC 3.00%、ROIC 0.46%、PBR 0.40倍。売上増強、粗利率改善、販管費抑制、自社株買収・増配検討により、FY3/29 までに ROE 2.20% を目指す。中期計画に沿い実行。
